params.text:
The command to clone the best GAN python implementation with SSH is:

git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2223/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git

This repository is 'PyTorch-GAN' by Erik Linder-Norén, which is a comprehensive collection of PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks with 45 stars. It contains implementations of numerous GAN variants including: Auxiliary Classifier GAN, Adversarial Autoencoder, BEGAN, BicycleGAN, Conditional GAN, CycleGAN, DCGAN, InfoGAN, Pix2Pix, StarGAN, Wasserstein GAN, and many more. The project appears to be well-maintained and popular within the GitLab instance.
